# 2 Baruch Chapter 75 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** After hearing all these words from the angel Ramiel, I fell face down on the ground and lay there for a long time.

**2** Ramiel said to me: "Why are you lying on the ground?"

**3** I said: "Because I am deeply troubled, Ramiel. I am afraid of the Mighty One's wrath — for all these things are coming because of human sin."

**4** Ramiel said to me: "Get up, and I will speak to you about the righteousness of the Mighty One."

**5** I got up, and he said: "Baruch, if you were not worthy to receive this revelation, you would never have been shown these things."

**6** "The Most High has not revealed to many what he has revealed to you; he has not shown to many what he has shown to you; and no one else has heard what you have heard."

**7** "Many have seen visions — but not everything you have seen. Many have heard prophecies — but not everything you have heard."

**8** "So take heart and do not be afraid. You have been set apart for this purpose."

**9** After Ramiel had finished speaking with me, he went away. Then I woke from my sleep.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
